class.name: IfcMaterialRelationship
class.brief_description: IfcMaterialRelationship defines a relationship between part and whole in material definitions (as in composite materials). The parts, expressed by the set of RelatedMaterials , are material constituents of which a single material aggregate is composed. HISTORYÿNew Entity in IFC2x4
class.description: Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files.

members.member: Reference to the relating material (the composite). Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.

Reference to related materials (as constituents of composite material). An Array of GDIFCEntityBase entities, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
In IFC4 files, this is the [code]Expression[/code] attribute. A String, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
